title: qa-gate sector pack
description: Profession-specific duties German law adds on top of the generic Impressum/Datenschutz rules (lib/web/legal/packs/<sector>.json). Every pattern names the law it comes from; `manual` lists duties no tool can verify; `pruefen` lists the open questions for a lawyer. Validated by scripts/validate-packs.mjs.

sector.description: Equals the file name without .json; the value of legal.sector in qa-gate.config.json.

title.description: Human name of the profession, German.

reviewedAt.description: Date the sources were last read (YYYY-MM-DD).

sources.description: Official sources: gesetze-im-internet.de, the Kammer, the supervising authority.

impressumPatterns.description: Patterns the Impressum text must contain (Kammer, register, Aufsichtsbehörde, Haftpflicht …).

statements.description: Statements that must appear on the given pages (Erstinformation, Preisangaben, DSGVO Art. 9 …).

requiredLinks.description: Links that must exist somewhere on the audited pages (berufsrechtliche Regelungen, Register).

forbiddenWords.description: Advertising wording the profession may not use (HWG, UWG, StBerG …).

manual.description: Duties the gate cannot verify; they go into the evidence bundle for the human reviewer.

pruefen.description: Open legal questions a lawyer must settle before selling the sector as 'konform'.

pages.description: Where to look: a named legal page, the start page, any audited page, or a concrete route such as /preise.

regex.description: JavaScript regular expression, matched case-insensitively against the page text.

law.description: Statute and paragraph, e.g. 'DDG § 5 Abs. 1 Nr. 3'.

hrefRegex.description: Matched against href attributes of every audited page.
